reason: Repair the governed and security merge workflows so the external dependency-review provider is invoked only when the trusted PR diff contains an actual dependency manifest, while preserving all deterministic governance, security, PentaSerialized, and provider review requirements.

changes.reason: Add a trusted-diff dependency-manifest detector, retain provider dependency review for real manifest changes, and emit an explicit governed no-op when dependency review is not applicable instead of allowing the external provider action to time out on unrelated PRs.

Scope the security dependency-review job to actual dependency-manifest changes after exact base/head resolution, preserving the pinned provider review for applicable diffs and recording a deterministic no-op for non-dependency changes.

exclusions: No required governance, security, PentaSerialized, documentation, runtime, or release check was removed.
No dependency review is skipped when a supported dependency manifest changes.
No provider credential, payment authority, settlement intent, or production money movement was created or executed.
